findings.evidence: AlgebraicSet.lean:445 `theorem quotientGHom_ext {φ ψ : GHom (quotientCoeff N) ι}`, where `ι` comes from `variable (ι : G →* H)` at line 90. AlgebraicSet.lean:472 `def coeff ... := GX.quotientCoeff _`. AlgebraicSet.lean:515-517 `gHom_ext ... := GX.quotientGHom_ext h`. AlgebraicSet.lean:404 `eval_eq_comp_mk'`.
findings.fix: Generalize `CoordGroup.gHom_ext` (AlgebraicSet.lean:515) to `{K} [Group K] {κ : G →* K} {φ ψ : GHom (coeff ι S) κ}` with the unchanged proof `GX.quotientGHom_ext h`. Delete `gHom_ext'` and use `gHom_ext ι T` at WordMap.lean:122 and :139.
findings.issue: `gHom_ext'` is directly replaced by `GX.quotientGHom_ext`, whose codomain `ι` is a free section variable. It is also just `CoordGroup.gHom_ext` with the codomain generalized. The 20-line proof redoes `GX.eval_eq_comp_mk'` by hand.

findings.evidence: AlgebraicSet.lean:536-560 (`homOfWordMap` via `QuotientGroup.map _ _ σ.toMonoidHom (Rad_preimage_le_comap ι σ S)`). AlgebraicSet.lean:347-355 `Rad_preimage_le_comap`, which uses `wordMap_mem_V ι σ S v hv`. ChangeOfCoordinates.lean:126 uses `homOfWordMap`.
findings.fix: Redefine `homOfWordMap ι σ S` as `homOfMapsToWordMap ι (σ ⁻¹' S) S (fun y => σ (inr (FreeGroup.of y))) (wordMap_mem_V ι σ S)`, after aligning the S/T argument order, and derive its `_mk`, `homEquiv_comp_` and `Rad_preimage_le_comap` lemmas from the general ones. Alternatively, prove `homOfWordMap ι σ S = homOfMapsToWordMap ...` and reduce the special-case lemmas to it.
findings.issue: `homOfMapsToWordMap`, `homOfMapsToWordMap_mk`, `homEquiv_comp_homOfMapsToWordMap` and `Rad_le_comap_of_mapsToWordMap` duplicate, in general form, the existing `homOfWordMap`, `homOfWordMap_mk`, `homEquiv_comp_homOfWordMap` and `Rad_preimage_le_comap` (the case `T = σ ⁻¹' S`). No lemma relates the two, leaving two disconnected APIs for the same construction.

summary: `gHom_ext'` restates the existing `GX.quotientGHom_ext` (which accepts any codomain) up to unfolding `coeff`, and its long proof redoes `GX.eval_eq_comp_mk'`. The new word-map construction duplicates `homOfWordMap` without linking to it.
